spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unheld, undetained.
m. (-तः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
अ neg. धृत held.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Contained, supported.
E.
आङ् before धृ to have, क्त aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Laxity, want of firm hold.
2 Want of steadiness or firmness.
E.
अ neg. धृति holding.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Ashamed, modest, humble.
E.
अ neg. धृष्ट proud.

f. (-ता)
Modesty, diffidence: also अधृष्टत्व n. (-त्वं)
E.
ता or त्व added to the last.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
Proud, vain.
f. (-ष्या)
The name of a river.
E.
अ neg. and धृष to be proud; than whom nought is prouder.
